note: Lowering the width with larger amplitude is carried. The choice of the common decay rate for the incoming stages and the order of widths above the strict inequality `w^path < w'` is not stated; no declaration gives Bounds at a width above the stage width.

lemma narrower {a b C D u v : ℝ} {R : PathData G} {p : Clip}
    (h : R.Bounds p a C u) (hp : 0 < b) (hb : b ≤ a) (hC : C ≤ D) (hu : u ≤ v) : R.Bounds p b D v := by
  have hh (x : ℕ) : Real.exp (b * ↑x) ≤ Real.exp (a * ↑x) := Real.exp_monotone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (by positivity))
  have hg {k : ℕ} (A : Atom G k) : 0 ≤ A.budget b ∧ A.budget b ≤ A.budget a := by
    unfold Atom.budget
    have hk : 0 ≤ A.magnitude := by unfold Atom.magnitude; positivity
    exact ⟨by positivity,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hh _) hk⟩
  exact ⟨hp,fun p => smaller (h.rows p) (fun i => ⟨by positivity, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hh _) (by positivity)⟩) hC,
    smaller h.two (fun _ => hg _) hu, smaller h.three (fun _ => hg _) hC, smaller h.four (fun _ => hg _) hC,
    h.invariant,h.symTerms,h.metric,h.loopTerms,h.loop_normal⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `narrower` passes `Bounds` at width `a` to any width `b ≤ a` with larger amplitude and loop bound.

structure Installed (P : Before) (a : Levels G) (V : Horizon a) (Q : ℕ → ℕ → PathData G) : Prop where
  prices : PathInputs P a Q
  linear N m : m ≤ N → Billed P a V N m (Q N m)
  uses N m : m ≤ N → let i := a.params m
    ∀ σ C w : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ i.width → i.paths ≤ C → a.clock.loopCap m ≤ w →
      (Q N m).Bounds i.clip σ C w

include h in

proof_context.conclusion: `uses` gives `Bounds` at every `0<σ≤width` with `paths ≤ C` and `loopCap ≤ w`.
